newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nikko unit in joint venture with Brunei bank.
newsitem.headline: Nikko unit in joint venture with Brunei bank.

text.p: Japan's Nikko International Capital Management Co Ltd, an investment advisory unit of Nikko Securities Co., will set up an asset management joint venture with Brunei's largest commercial bank.

Islamic Bank of Brunei (IBB) will take a 51 percent stake in the 800 million yen joint venture while Nikko International Capital is to hold 49 percent, a spokesman at Nikko Securities said on Thursday.
IBB Nikko Capital Management, to be headquartered in Brunei, will begin operations on Thursday, the spokesman said.
The company will target institutional and individual investors in Brunei, Singapore and the Middle East.
As the first step, the joint venture plans to launch an open-end equity fund called the IBB Nikko Asia Fund.
The fund will mainly invest in Asian equities, including those in Japan and Australia.
